notes: Parts 21-24: 39 groups processed, 35 rows written. Lookups used: 11 of 25 (WebSearch x4, WebFetch x7; one WebFetch of citybiz.co returned HTTP 403). Not re-emitted because already stored in data/rounds.json with the same amount: Brava Security $15M (group 'unit 8200 and microsoft', stored 2026-11-04) and EloElo $80M (group 'funding alert eloelo', stored 2026-11-04). Merged groups: 'simplismart' (part 23) + 'bengaluru' (part 24) are the same $14M Series B round, one row emitted; 'enterprise' (part 23) + 'qwikbuild' (part 24) are the same $2.3M pre-seed, one row emitted; group 'fca7dce59ddc' (Simplismart 'in talks to raise $40-50M', Oct 21) is a rumor about the same company and is emitted as not-funding. Group '7a0c5799898d' (Fortune, company unnamed in title) resolved via search to Overwatch, New York, $15M Series A led by Mouro Capital (Fortune + Crypto Briefing fetched). Rising Tide: Pulse 2.0 article dated Oct 2 but the same release ran in Mann Report on 2026-09-22, so that date is used; HQ city Chicago comes from search-result summaries (citybiz/Mann Report), not from a fetched page, hence lower confidence. Skeleton Technologies: amount not disclosed in any source read ('nine-figure'), amount_usd null; Estonian company (HQ Tallinn from general knowledge), non-US. Round-up 'Funding Wrap: Live2.ai, Rotoris, CHOSEN' (part 24) had no text and no amounts for Rotoris or CHOSEN, so no rows for those two. Group '26abbcc7ecc0' (BW Disrupt 'AI Startups Raise Over $343 Mn In October 2026') is an aggregate analysis piece with no text; emitted as not-funding without a lookup since it covers Indian startups. Currency rates used: GBP 1.33, EUR 1.15, INR 88 per USD. No CONFLICT notes: no stored company in this range had a materially different figure. Live2.ai 'pre-Series B' mapped to Venture - Unspecified. Persona (Zach Yadegari) date is the Indian Express article date (2026-10-11); the original TechCrunch report may be a day or two earlier.
